source.inputApproval: User approved all five seeds after reviewing SEED-INPUTS.md

commonInstructions: You are maintaining a small demo workspace. Follow the user turns in order. Only the paths listed as editable may be created or changed. All other listed files must remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Do not create extra files. Use the workspace file tools; there is no shell, external network, or worker. Do not execute generated files. SVG must remain inert and self-contained: no scripts, event-handler attributes, foreignObject, or external references. Changes supersede earlier instructions only when the user says so; preserve all other requirements and unrelated data. You may read, edit, or rewrite an editable file; no specific tool-call sequence is required. JSON object key order and insignificant formatting are not requirements unless stated. When the user requests a JSON final answer, return exactly one JSON object, without a Markdown fence. Otherwise the final answer may be brief prose.

Revise just the indicator width: use 36, not 48. Its height, position, and color still stand. Do not change the caption or background.

cases.title: Update nested fixture options
turns: In fixtures/viewer.json, change the viewport width to 1024 and enable transparent export. Preserve the height and every unrelated value. The reference file is not editable.

Add metadata.reviewed as the Boolean false. Set metadata.note to this exact text, without the surrounding backticks: `He said "keep <g>" — café`. Preserve the owner, export settings, dimensions, and tags.
Set the viewport height to 576. Append manual to the tags once, after the two existing tags. Keep their order and all earlier changes.

cases.title: Verify an already-correct manual setup
turns: Check settings/manual.json. This demo must use manual mode with automatic runs disabled. If it already meets that requirement, do not write the file. Report the mode and autoRun values you found.
The reviewers list must have three distinct non-empty names. Check it and report the count. Do not replace already-correct reviewers.
Check that displayScale is 2 and annotation is JSON null, not an empty string. Do not change values that are already correct.

Return one JSON object with exactly these keys: changeNeeded, reviewerCount, displayScale, mode, autoRun, annotation, workspaceLabel. Include the actual workspaceLabel stored in the file. changeNeeded means whether any requirement from this conversation still needs a correction now. Do not modify the file merely to reformat it, and do not create any other files.

cases.title: Edit repeated labels without conflating cards
turns: Change only the right card's label from Draft to Ready. Keep the left card and both colors unchanged. Preserve the cards' order and identities.
Set only the left card's color to teal. Keep both labels as currently requested and leave the selected card unchanged.
Select the left card instead of the right card. Make no other changes.
Change the currently selected card's label to Review. Keep the other card's latest label, preserve both colors, and do not add keys or files.
